description:
At FBFX, Adam Savage puts on the original armored bracers made for Batman's costume in Batman Begins and learns how the team made both stunt versions of the armor as well as sharp steel gauntlets made for breaking ninja swords!

Learn more about FBFX’s work at https://www.fbfx.co.uk/
